extracted.intended_audience: Christian lay readers / parishioners seeking moral instruction
extracted.subtask_description: Religious moral prose describing how to recognize pride and related vices, why pride is common, and the spiritual consequences—illustrated through the life and actions of 'Mr. Badman.'

rubrics_metrics.name: There are two sorts of Pride; Pride of Spirit, and Pride of Body
rubrics_metrics.description: There are two sorts of Pride; Pride of Spirit, and Pride of Body.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scripture passages indicate both kinds are sinful: ‘every one that is proud in heart is abomination to the Lord’ and bodily ornaments and fashions are condemned. Both are sin and abominable to the Lord; Mr. Badman would avoid such texts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Heart Pride is discovered by a stretched out Neck and by mincing as they go
rubrics_metrics.description: Heart Pride is discovered by a stretched out Neck, and by mincing as they go.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outward gestures—proud neck, proud foot, proud tongue—manifest a proud heart: scornful looks, rugged speech, and huffing carriage among neighbours.

rubrics_metrics.name: A proud heart is a persecuting one
rubrics_metrics.description: A proud heart, is a persecuting one: The wicked through his pride doth persecute the poor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Persecution of the vulnerable is a symptom of pride of heart.

rubrics_metrics.name: A prayerless man is a proud man
rubrics_metrics.description: A prayerless man is a proud man.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The absence of prayer is given as a clear sign of pride of heart.

rubrics_metrics.name: A contentious man is a proud man
rubrics_metrics.description: A contentious man is a proud man.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Constant quarrelsomeness and contentious behavior are symptomatic of pride.

rubrics_metrics.name: The disdainful man is a proud man
rubrics_metrics.description: The disdainful man is a proud man.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A habit of disdain or looking down on others signals a proud heart.

rubrics_metrics.name: The man that oppresses his neighbour is a proud man
rubrics_metrics.description: The man that oppresses his neighbour is a proud man.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Oppression of neighbours is listed as evidence of pride.

rubrics_metrics.name: He that hearkeneth not to God's Word with reverence is a proud man
rubrics_metrics.description: He that hearkeneth not to Gods Word with reverence and fear, is a proud man.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disregard or irreverence toward Scripture and its authority marks pride.

rubrics_metrics.name: He that calls the proud happy is a proud man
rubrics_metrics.description: And he that calls the proud happy, is, be sure, a proud man.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Endorsing or admiring the proud is taken as evidence of pride in the admirer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bodily pride signified by ornaments, fashions, and affected gestures
rubrics_metrics.description: The putting on of Gold, and Pearls, and costly array; the pleating of the hair, the following of fashions, the seeking by gestures to imitate the proud, either by speech, looks, dresses, goings, or other fools baubles ... all these ... are signs of bodily pride.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: External adorning—gold, pearls, changing fashions, mantles, wimples, crisping pins, fine linen, hoods, veils, ear-rings, nose-jewels, etc.—reveals bodily pride and also indicates pride of heart.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excuses used to deny pride (neatness, comeliness, cleanliness)
rubrics_metrics.description: Many will not allow this should be called Pride, but rather neatness, handsomness, comeliness, cleanliness...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The tendency to re-label prideful dress and conduct as ‘neat’ or ‘comely’ is an anti-pattern used to avoid admitting sin.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reason for pride: led by their own hearts rather than by the Word of God
rubrics_metrics.description: Because such persons are led by their own hearts, rather than by the Word of God.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The heart's natural tendency lifts people into pride when it is followed over Scripture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reason for pride: imitating worldly examples rather than true saints
rubrics_metrics.description: They are more apt to take example of those that are of the World, than they are to take example of those that are Saints indeed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Following worldly fashions and exemplars fosters pride; instead, one should take patterns from holy saints of old.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reason for pride: forgetting the pollution of their nature
rubrics_metrics.description: They have forgotten the pollution of their Nature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A lack of awareness of human baseness and sinfulness removes humility and permits pride to grow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reason for pride: having God and his Holiness out of sight
rubrics_metrics.description: Persons that are proud, have gotten God and his Holiness out of their sight.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to behold God's holiness and majesty leads to delighting in vain adorning and prideful manners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of pride: makes man like the Devil (angels fell by pride)
rubrics_metrics.description: ’Tis pride that makes poor Man so like the Devil in Hell, that he cannot in it be known to be the Image and similitude of God.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pride lifts and puffs up the heart, making a person bear the image of the Devil (parallel to angels becoming devils by pride).

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of pride: makes a man odious in the sight of God
rubrics_metrics.description: Pride makes a man so odious in the sight of God, that he shall not, must not come nigh his Majesty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: God respects the lowly but keeps the proud at a distance; pride prevents coming near to God.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of pride: God resists the proud; pride keeps God and the soul apart
rubrics_metrics.description: As pride sets, so it keeps God and the Soul at a distance. God resisteth the proud; resists, that is, he opposes him, he thrusts him from him...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A proud person may attend ordinances but will not have true communion or blessing because God opposes the proud.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of pride: The Lord will destroy the House of the proud
rubrics_metrics.description: The Word saith, that The Lord will destroy the House of the proud.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Biblical examples (Pharaoh, Korah) are cited; pride leads to divine destruction of the proud and their houses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of pride: pride is a forerunner of judgment—shame and destruction follow
rubrics_metrics.description: Pride, where it comes, and is entertained, is a certain forerunner of some Judgment that is not far behind... Pride goeth before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pride precedes shame and ruin; this proverb is used as moral teaching.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of pride: persisting pride makes condition remediless as devils
rubrics_metrics.description: Persisting in pride makes the condition of a poor man as remediless as is that of the Devils themselves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unrepentant pride hardens the heart and leads to a state like the devils—hopeless without divine mercy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ungodly life-sign: denial of God in word and action
rubrics_metrics.description: Instead of believing that there was a God, his Mouth, his Life and Actions declared, that he believed no such thing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A life and speech that deny or act as if there is no God indicate deep ungodliness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ungodly sign: ascribing mercies and crosses to fortune or self rather than God
rubrics_metrics.description: Instead of honouring God ... he would ascribe the glory to other causes ... to his own wit, labour, care, industry, cunning... if they were Crosses, he would ascribe them... to Fortune, ill Luck, Chance, the ill mannagement of matters, the ill will of neighbours, or to his wife's being Religious.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to acknowledge God for providences and misattributing events to self or chance is cited as proof of spiritual blindness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disrespect for Scripture and preaching as evidence of pride
rubrics_metrics.description: When he heard it preached, read, or discoursed of, he would sleep, talk of other Business, or else object against the authority, harmony, and wisdom of the Scriptures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sleeping, talking, or raising cavils against Scripture when it is read or preached are behaviors indicating contempt and pride.

rubrics_metrics.name: Slandering and mocking godly people as a sign of wickedness
rubrics_metrics.description: Instead of loving and honouring of them that did bear ... the matter of his Jests, and the objects of his slanders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mockery, slander, and delight in circulating lies against godly people are described as typical of Mr. Badman and symptomatic of a corrupt heart.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anger and wrath as marks of foolish, sinful temper
rubrics_metrics.description: He was an angry, wrathfull, envious man, a man that knew not what meekness or gentleness meant... His natural temper was to be surly, huffie, and rugged...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anger that rests in the bosom is cited from Solomon as a sign of foolishness; habitual wrath is a vice revealing a sinful disposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Envy as a malignant root producing many other sins
rubrics_metrics.description: Envy is a devilish thing... reckoned among the foulest Villanies... it rots the very bones of him in whom it dwells. A sound heart is life to the flesh, but envy the rottenness of the bones.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Envy is described as the 'Father and Mother' of many wickednesses; it is heavy as a stone, kills both giver and receiver, caused the persecution of Christ, the selling of Joseph, divisions among saints, and is the nursery of whisperings, debates, backbitings, slanders, reproaches, murders, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Absence of true repentance—temporary terror in sickness is not saving remorse
rubrics_metrics.description: It is a rare case that he should never in all his life be touched with remorse for his ill-spent life... he cried out in his pain... but whether it was that his sin might be pardoned, and his soul saved, or whether to be rid of his pain, I will not positively determine; though I fear it was but for the last.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fear and cries in sickness that cease upon recovery are presented as counterfeit or superficial repentance rather than genuine conversion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drunkenness and its consequences (accidents, death, associated sins)
rubrics_metrics.description: Drunkards ride like madmen; one broke his leg coming home drunk; others broke necks or died in drink. Drunkenness is accompanied by oaths, blasphemies, lies, revellings, whoreings, brawlings, &c.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Drunkenness is judged heinous and commonly leads to deadly accidents and is linked with many other sins; examples are given as warnings and divine judgments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delight in raising and telling lies about the godly
rubrics_metrics.description: I do think it was as delightful to Mr. Badman to hear, raise, and tell lies, and lying stories of them that fear the Lord, as it was for him to go to bed when a weary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Taking pleasure in inventing or spreading falsehoods about religious people is a moral failing highlighted in the character study.
